model: F_axis = M_eff * dv/dt + D_linear * v + bias
method: Exact position-domain integration at 0.01 s; grid search over positive M_eff/D_linear; independent initial position/velocity per positive and negative phase; shared force bias. Camera and RPM are aligned by the camera header timestamp on the host monotonic clock.

camera.coordinate: midpoint of tag 15/16 raw pinhole PnP positions in fixed camera frame, projected on initial body axis

force.source: current-vehicle measured RPM converted by disabled historical FinsSim load-cell c1 prior
force.rpm_isolated_outlier_filter: 5-sample local median; replace deviations greater than max(150 RPM, 30% of local median)

reasons: force scale is a historical curve prior, not a current-vehicle load-cell measurement
the ROV is tethered, so external tether force is not separated from hydrodynamic damping
raw underwater pinhole PnP is not refraction corrected
one command amplitude cannot independently identify linear and quadratic damping
